title: Quantisierung als Eigenwertproblem: Erste Mitteilung
lineage: Inspected primary text or later historical source; see locator and qualification.

passages.note: The first 1926 paper replaced a quantization prescription with an eigenvalue problem and applied it to the nonrelativistic unperturbed hydrogen atom. The first communication is not the later time-dependent equation or proof of equivalence to matrix mechanics. DOI ending 40602 is the fourth communication.
